title: Disc Golf
description: A mod that adds the sport of Disc Golf into Minecraft! Adds 5 new items: Putter, Mid-range, Driver, Disc Golf Bag, and Disc Golf Basket
body:
A simple mod that adds the sport of Disc Golf into Minecraft! This mod adds 5 new items: Putter, Mid-range, Driver, Disc Golf Bag, and Disc Golf Basket.

Discs: Putter has the shortest throws but the striaghtest and most accurate. Mid-range is a nice in-between distance of a Putter and Driver. The Driver has the furthest throw when you need distance.

Disc Golf Bag: When holding the Disc Golf Bag, pressing Right-Click will open the bag so you can store your discs. Left-Clicking any block while holding the bag will recall all thrown discs back to the bag (Convenient when practicing and throwing a large number of discs). 

Disc Golf Basket: Placing the Disc Golf Basket block will spawn a basket that is 2 blocks tall. The base made out of an End Rod and the top block is the basket. When throwing and hitting the basket with a disc, fireworks will shoot out of the top and a text will display letting you know you scored.
